hook: The new Prado vs the Everest V6. Both tow 3.5 tonnes. One costs $5k less.

stories.a: Sips less and carries 30 L more fuel, so it goes further between servos.
stories.b: V6 with 100 Nm more, same 3,500 kg towing, and still about $5k cheaper. Seven seats in both.
stories.take: The Everest wins the tow. The Prado wins the outback.

_sources: Carsales 'Ford Everest Sport v Toyota Prado GXL comparison' (Feb 2025): Prado GXL 2.8 turbo-diesel 48V, 150 kW/500 Nm, 7.6 L/100km, 110 L tank, $79,990; Everest Sport V6 184 kW/600 Nm, 8.5 L/100km, 80 L tank; both 3500 kg braked towing
Chasing Cars 'Prado GXL vs Everest Sport' (Mar 2025): Everest Sport V6 $74,640 +ORC, Prado GXL $79,990, 7.6 vs 8.5 L/100km, 110 L vs 80 L
Chasing Cars (same article): payload Prado GXL 615 kg, Everest Sport V6 703 kg
NRMA '2025 Toyota Prado vs Ford Everest comparison review': Everest Sport V6 $74,640 before on-roads, $5,350 less than Prado GXL ($79,990), 150/500 vs 184/600
Note: Carsales printed the Everest price as $74,690; two other sources say $74,640, used here
